items.headline: Albemarle Swings To Q2 Profit
items.snippet: Albemarle Corp. (ALB) posted a profit for the second quarter, as revenues rose driven by stronger lithium pricing in its Energy Storage business and improved pricing and volumes in its Specialties segment. Net sales increased 31.1% to $1.74 billion from $1.33 billion last year.
